title: geranium transbaicalicum subsp. turczaninovii
intro: Geranium transbaicalicum subsp. turczaninovii, commonly known as Sibirian geranium, is a plant species in the family Geraniaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to promote relaxation, reduce inflammation, and support the immune system. The health benefits of Sibirian geranium include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes. The therapeutic actions of Sibirian geranium include promoting wound healing, reducing anxiety and stress, and supporting the body's natural defenses against infections and diseases.
